name: Halim Family Women in STEM Scholarship (UQ)
summary: Aspire scheme scholarship for women starting a STEM bachelor at UQ who hold the Queensland Commitment Scholarship.
who: Domestic female student commencing a bachelor program with a significant component of STEM, with no prior bachelor-level study.
Maximum points in the Financial Hardship category of QTAC's Educational Access Scheme.
how: Apply using the online form. One application covers all scholarships in the Aspire Scholarship scheme.
catches: Value may vary. UQ doesn't publish a fixed amount.
Applications opened 17 August 2026 and close 26 February 2027.
